profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I at Braze
profile.summary:
Engineer by degree, web developer by passion. My journey into development began unexpectedly at a small web development company, where I quickly transitioned from support roles to building client websites—and discovered my love for coding in the process.

Over the years, I've had the privilege of working alongside talented teams in New York City and Chicago, constantly expanding my technical expertise. At B&H Photo Video, I contributed to maintaining one of the industry's top-rated mobile e-commerce experiences, focusing on responsive design and intuitive user interfaces. Currently at Trading Technologies, I've deepened my expertise in React and modern JavaScript, building sophisticated trading applications that demand real-time performance, precision, and seamless user experiences in high-stakes financial environments.

My approach centers on creating responsive, intuitive interfaces that connect users with the information and tools they need. As a front-end developer specializing in React and mobile-first development, I believe that clean code and thoughtful UX design are essential to delivering experiences that feel effortless—even when the underlying complexity is significant.

Based in the Chicago suburbs, I'm committed to staying in the Chicagoland area and continuing to build innovative web applications that make a difference. I'm always eager to collaborate with teams that value craftsmanship, continuous learning, and creating exceptional digital experiences.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Conceptualized and incorporated in early 2026 — building a peer-to-peer marketplace from 0 to 1 connecting local skill teachers with learners for in-person experiences, fully self-directed from product conception through technical architecture. Architecting and developing full-stack application using Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL), and Node.js backend with Stripe Connect for marketplace payment processing. Designed and implemented geographic zip-gate restrictions, messaging system, and teacher/learner onboarding flows with a focus on clean, conversion-optimized UX.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained TTW (TT Web), a React-based trading platform for institutional brokers handling real-time market data and trade execution across global exchanges. Worked extensively with AWS infrastructure including CloudFormation, Lambda, EC2, and DynamoDB to ensure high availability and system resilience. Focused on performance optimization, building modular component architecture, and collaborating with cross-functional teams on trading platform features.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: Supported full-stack development for a high-volume e-commerce platform serving millions of customers. Built mobile-optimized features using Backbone.js and JavaScript, developed customer engagement tools like wishlist functionality, and integrated RESTful APIs for product catalog and payment systems.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Provided full-stack development support for high-volume e-commerce platform serving millions of customers annually. Developed and launched desktop wishlist feature, enhancing customer engagement and retention through personalized shopping experiences. Led development of mobile-optimized website using Backbone.js and JavaScript, delivering responsive shopping experience across devices. Integrated RESTful APIs for product catalog, inventory management, and payment processing systems.

positions.title: Junior Developer / Technologist
positions.description: Developed responsive HTML email campaigns and web applications for major advertising clients. Created internal applications using JavaScript, Node.js, and Backbone while collaborating with the design team to build interactive digital experiences.

positions.title: Co-Owner / Developement Lead
positions.description: Founded and operated a web development consultancy serving small businesses in the Chicago area. Built custom WordPress and Magento e-commerce solutions, developed customer management systems, and managed all aspects of the business including client relations, team supervision, and project delivery for over 50 clients.

positions.title: Product Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked at Parker for 8 months while I was in school.  While at Parker, I assisted in the development of the "seven-step" problem resolution of quality issues for warranty returns on specific product lines, created, implemented, and updated manufacturing process documents, applied the use of LEAN manufacturing and my knowledge of facilities planning and managerial engineering to redesign cells and reduce the part quantities in Kanbans, and performed time studies that will eventually be used to decrease process time and increase part productivity.
